topic: A person finds out their surprise party has been cancelled
text: I understand how disappointing it must feel to learn that the surprise party planned for you has been called off. Sometimes, things don't go as we hope, and it can really sting, especially when it's something special. I want you to know that it’s okay to feel upset about it. It’s a big deal, and it’s natural to have big feelings. Maybe we can think about other ways to celebrate you that might still make you feel special and appreciated. What would make you smile today, even a little?
